judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a cow with clearly recognizable bovine features, including a body, head, four legs, tail, and udder.
The cow must have black and white patches for its coloring.
Add cow ears, eyes, and snout for facial recognition.
Position the cow in a realistic plowing stance, leaning forward as if pulling.
The cow's hooves must be colored brown, as if covered in soil from the field.
requirements.note: Hoof fill samples RGB (43,43,43) - a perfectly neutral dark grey with zero red-minus-blue spread; the hooves are black, not brown.

requirements.text: Include a traditional wooden plow with a visible metal blade/share.
Depict a wooden yoke across the cow's shoulders, connected to the plow by visible chains.
requirements.note: A brown neck strap and two smooth trace lines run back to the plow; there is no yoke beam across the shoulders and the traces carry no links, so no chains are visible.

requirements.text: The plow's blade must be partially buried in the soil, actively turning over a chunk of earth.
requirements.note: Not partially buried: the grey share is drawn on top of the tilled plane with its outline complete and unbroken. No soil mass - no ground fill, mound, furrow wall or attached slice of earth - covers any part of it, and the field is an oblique top-down plane with no drawn soil-surface line for the silhouette to cross. The small dark blob at the share's tip is a detached clod, which the convention excludes from the buried clause.

requirements.text: Show at least three distinct, dark furrows in the soil trailing directly behind the plow.
The field must be split into a plowed section and an unplowed section, with the cow and plow positioned at the boundary between them.
requirements.note: The field is bare brown soil edge to edge with furrow lines throughout; there is no unplowed section, so there is no boundary for the cow and plow to be positioned at.

requirements.text: The unplowed section of the field must have short green grass, which is visibly being overturned by the plow.
requirements.note: There is no green grass anywhere in the field - the whole field is bare tilled soil - so nothing green is being overturned.

requirements.text: Add a simple background with a clear horizon line and a blue sky containing a yellow sun.
